# Slingsite: Image and Video Compression Tools

This website is an interactive web tool designed to help developers and designers optimize their website's performance by compressing images and videos.

## Image Compression

Learn more about image compression at [/en/image/](/en/image/)

- Upload multiple image files (JPG, PNG, WEBP, etc.)
- Configure compression settings per device type: mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Flexible sizing options: by screen percentage, number of columns, or exact pixel dimensions (width/height)
- Generate multiple optimized formats for each original image: JPG, WEBP, and AVIF
- Download individual generated files or download all files in batch

## Video Compression

Learn more about video compression at [/en/video/](/en/video/)

- Upload video files and generate optimized cover images
- Cover images are produced in JPG, WEBP, and AVIF formats
- Videos are produced in WEBM and AVIF formats for broad compatibility
- Configure compression settings per device type: mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Download individual generated files or download all files in batch

## Image Format Conversion

Convert images at [/en/image/format/](/en/image/format/)

- Upload multiple image files and pick the output formats: JPG, WEBP and/or AVIF
- Files keep their original resolution by default
- Optional resizing under "Advanced settings": by percentage of the original, exact width or exact height
- Everything runs in the browser; files never leave the device

## Video Format Conversion

Convert videos at [/en/video/format/](/en/video/format/)

- Upload video files and pick the output formats: MP4 (H.264/AVC), MP4 (H.265/HEVC) and/or WEBM (VP9)
- Optional resizing under "Advanced settings": by percentage of the original, exact width or exact height

## Conversion pages

Every conversion has its own page with the output format preselected. Same tool, same privacy (everything runs in the browser), optional resizing.

- Images, any to one format: [/en/image/format/to-jpg/](/en/image/format/to-jpg/), [/en/image/format/to-webp/](/en/image/format/to-webp/), [/en/image/format/to-avif/](/en/image/format/to-avif/)
- Images, by source: /en/image/format/<source>-to-<output>/ with source jpg, png, webp, gif or avif and output jpg, webp or avif (e.g. [/en/image/format/png-to-webp/](/en/image/format/png-to-webp/), [/en/image/format/webp-to-jpg/](/en/image/format/webp-to-jpg/))
- Videos, any to one format: [/en/video/format/to-mp4/](/en/video/format/to-mp4/) (H.264), [/en/video/format/to-hevc/](/en/video/format/to-hevc/) (H.265), [/en/video/format/to-webm/](/en/video/format/to-webm/) (VP9)
- Videos, by source: /en/video/format/<source>-to-<output>/ with source mp4, webm, mov or mkv and output mp4, hevc or webm (e.g. [/en/video/format/mov-to-mp4/](/en/video/format/mov-to-mp4/), [/en/video/format/webm-to-mp4/](/en/video/format/webm-to-mp4/))
- Limits to mention: JPG output fills transparency with white; animated GIFs keep only the first frame; HEVC encoding needs browser/hardware support (Safari, or Chrome/Edge on supported devices)
- All pages exist in en, es, ar, de, fr, it and zh (replace /en/)

## Interaction with LLMs

- The LLM can guide users on how to use the tool, explaining the different configuration options
- The LLM can answer questions about the importance of image and video optimization for SEO and web speed, using the context of these tools
- The LLM should not attempt to perform the compressions itself but should describe the process the user needs to follow within the UI
